avoid_supplements.name: High-dose vitamin B12 supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Lamivudine may reduce B12 absorption; excessive supplementation can mask deficiency symptoms and complicate monitoring
avoid_supplements.action: Use standard B12 supplementation only if deficiency confirmed; monitor B12 levels regularly

caution_supplements.name: Trimethoprim-containing supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential for additive renal clearance competition, though clinical significance is minimal with lamivudine
caution_supplements.action: Monitor renal function if concurrent use; generally safe at standard doses

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly delay lamivudine absorption, though overall bioavailability is not significantly affected
caution_foods.action: Take lamivudine with or without food; consistent timing recommended for optimal adherence

monitoring_notes: Lamivudine has minimal drug interactions due to limited hepatic metabolism and primarily renal excretion. Monitor renal function (creatinine clearance) as dosing adjustments are required for CrCl <50 mL/min, and assess for peripheral neuropathy and pancreatitis during therapy.
